# AI Content Governance & Brand Safety — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Policy draft

*Module 1: Rules for generated content · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_content_policy_check.py`): Draft your own POLICY in ten lines. Test it on five recent assets. Which rule produced the most failures — and is the rule wrong, or the practice?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Response playbook

*Module 2: Brand risk · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_impersonation_response.py`): Run the table-top: it is 09:10 on a Monday and this video is spreading. Who does what in the first 60 minutes? Who has the platform escalation contact?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
